author: R1
objection: The region-naming lemma controls impurity but does not compare to a defined pointwise teacher; the positive example's spatial comparator was underspecified.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: One region contains 90% class c and 10% d; pointwise Q equals exact truth; pooled v=(.9,.1), beta=0, eta=.1, delta=0 satisfies the lemma but region voting has error .1 versus teacher 0.
author_response: Accepted. R1 appended a teacher comparator and exact impurity a, strict improvement conditions, the counterexample, and a five-location homogeneous-LV construction with four Q=(.1,0,0,.9) and one Q=(0,1,0,0), giving teacher error .2 and direct region-vote error 0.
modification: DOSSIERS/R1.md, Round 1 revision. The result is narrowed to a conditional error bound; improvement additionally requires teacher truth risk exceed impurity plus transfer exceptions. The positive example is explicitly denoising under a changed coarse-target policy, not native-boundary recovery.
remaining_disagreement: None on the mathematical correction; actual partition purity, naming validity and teacher truth risk remain unverified and latent.

author: R1
objection: Uniform per-pixel transfer delta is stronger than average CE; an explicit finite-measure tail bound would clarify what a measured weighted KL can support without implying population generalization.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: Pinsker: a target top-class margin m0 and student disagreement imply max-coordinate deviation at least m0/2, hence KL(t||p) at least m0^2/2. With w>=w0, exceptional mass is at most 2D/(w0*m0^2).
author_response: Accepted and derived the fixed-measure bound R(argmax p)<=a+b+2D/(w0*m0^2), retaining low-weight/low-margin mass b, selected-set normalization, target-policy identity and latent impurity/teacher risk. R1 also appended the requested observability qualification: the latent-name margin equals the observed top-target margin only under the naming premise, or the observed candidate may be defined while its truth impurity remains latent.
modification: DOSSIERS/R1.md, Round 1 revision, Finite-measure transfer bound. Full Pinsker and union-bound proof appended. D is KL to the proposed region target, not automatically current runner historical-Q loss.
remaining_disagreement: None. R1 acknowledged and appended the observability qualification; actual semantic validity and population transfer remain unverified.
